category_title: Adolescent with emotional/behavioral disorder and academic frustration
scenario_title: Independent mathematics assignment and quiz completion
minimal_context: Isaac is sitting at his desk during class time to complete an independent math quiz on a tablet.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Isaac, it is time for your independent math assignment. Please log into the tablet and complete the quiz questions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This is a waste of time. I'm not doing these stupid math problems.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to finish the assignment. Just do your best.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't do it! I don't know these facts! (Scribbles aggressively all over his assignment paper)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying, Isaac. Look at the next question on the tablet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I said I'm not doing it! (Grabs the tablet and throws it onto the floor, breaking it, then tears a page out of his math book)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Isaac, it is time for your independent math assignment. Please log into the tablet and complete the quiz questions.

STUDENT: This is a waste of time. I'm not doing these stupid math problems.

TUTOR: You need to finish the assignment. Just do your best.

STUDENT: I can't do it! I don't know these facts! (Scribbles aggressively all over his assignment paper)

TUTOR: Keep trying, Isaac. Look at the next question on the tablet.

STUDENT: I said I'm not doing it! (Grabs the tablet and throws it onto the floor, breaking it, then tears a page out of his math book)

task.content: Complete an independent mathematics assignment and answer quiz questions on a tablet; perform labs that required mathematical computations

context.materials: Math book, tablet, math flash cards, number line, computer with Math Flash software

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: The request to complete an independent mathematics assignment, or when he could not complete the assignment and could not answer quiz questions
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Refusal to participate in class, making sarcastic or disrespectful comments, destroying materials, scribbled on or tore up his assignments, tore pages out of his math book, broke a tablet in class
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Appeared to get easily frustrated; lacked fluency in mathematics facts

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Refusing to complete his work and causing disruptions in the classroom
